newsitem.title: NORWAY: POLL-Nycomed H1 profits seen lower.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Nycomed H1 profits seen lower.

text.p: Norwegian pharmaceuticals group Nycomed ASA is expected to present a first-half 1997 pre-tax profit of 563 million crowns, according to a consensus poll of eight analysts.
Four analysts said buy and the other four had a hold recommendation on the share.
Most analysts, in pricing the share, were little concerned with the H1 result, which was seen to be lower than in the corresponding 1996 period.
They looked instead to the planned merger with Britain's Amersham International Plc and Nycomed's renegotiations this autumn of two Imaging sales contracts in the United States.

Amersham, the health and technology group, announced on July 1 it planned to merge with Nycomed to create a global group, capitalised at 1.8 billion pounds, with a leading position in in-vivo diagnostic imaging agents and research-based biotechnology supply.
Nycomed will present the first-half result at 0700 GMT on August 7.
